name: A four-blade advancing double-cut combo aimed to the RIGHT.

She steps forward and swings the cyan sword with her near arm in a broad diagonal downward slash from high left to low right in front of her. Her hips twist and the other arm immediately swings the pink sword across the same enemy space in a powerful second downward slash. Each hand remains gripping its own hilt; elbows extend and shoulders rotate with real full-body follow-through. Immediately BOTH airborne swords launch from behind her shoulders into open space to the RIGHT: gold sweeps down in a rotating overhead slash, then purple follows in a separate crossing downward slash, at least one body-width in front of her chest. The floating swords move independently, not fixed to her back, not merely tilting. Four clear successive cutting arcs: cyan, pink, gold, purple.
